purpose: Fixed original FrDraw nodes: distinguish radial-shell volume quadrature sensitivity from moving nodes, changing R, or fitting the observed peak.
scope: One sealed server initial native state, three exact predeclared finite-Kw theory times .02, .04205180291164746, .0625 seconds after drainage. No solver, compilation, integration, source edit or formal-input mutation.

quadratures.A_native_equal_mass: Original native mass/rho with rho=2100; unchanged coordinates, h, R, geometry and material fields.
quadratures.B_shell_volume: Identify the original twenty exact-radius shells. Interfaces are adjacent-radius midpoints, innermost edge 0 and outermost edge R=.05. Each node receives exact shell volume divided by that shell's native node count. Recompute hypothetical mass=rho0*volume, correction C, raw momentum/load/pore terms, compression and symC Darcy consistently. No fit to pressure, peak, time or radial second moment.

numeric_convention: Reuse cryer_actual_budget_r1 moment/evaluate: double geometry and sums, production float kernel/Eta2/constants, float mass/rho division for C/compression/Darcy, float-projected analytic pressure/velocity/effective stress. Hypothetical B mass is a mathematical per-node coefficient, not a current solver-supported input. Analytic pressure on true surface nodes is exactly zero; surface neighbors remain in every sum.
checks: Hash initial Part0000, actual generated XML, Run.out, reader/source against the existing sealed full-native input manifest; do not rehash all BI4.
Check original initial IDs/native safety and all initial rho/mass values, reference arithmetic, positive moment eigenvalues and affine closure.
Reuse pair force cancellation, raw stress/pore work-adjoint identities and symC closed weighted-sum/nonpositive-pressure-work algebra checks.
Original region weights A remain fixed for direct comparisons. Also report each quadrature's own-weight metrics separately, without silently changing the measurement norm.
outputs: New tests/figures cryer_shell_quadrature_r1 regions/radial/quadrature/powers CSV plus one 3x2 PNG; tests/logs check JSON and log. Refuse every existing target.
limits: B integrates each shell volume exactly but does not force the discrete radial second moment to 3/5 or repair angular quadrature.
Native surface unclamped pressure RHS is diagnostic only; also report the prescribed drainage-clamped RHS separately.
The raw zeroth/difference vectors may cancel. Their RMS values are not additive error contributions.
This is a coefficient/quadrature sensitivity screen, not CUDA/FMA/cell-order replay, a dynamic density repair, a supported nonuniform-mass candidate or physical/full-half acceptance.
No instantaneous residual is integrated or converted into a contribution to the observed 128-Pa peak deficit or timing shift.
